senses.gloss: הִלְחִית (cmp. לָחַךְ) to loll the tongue (of the dog); to pant, be exhausted.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13:2">Lev. R. s. 13</cite> <he>החמור מהלך והכלב מַלְחִית</he> the ass walked (patiently) and the dog panted; Yalk. Hab. 563; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 343">Sifré Deut. 343</cite>.
